name: pd_oncalls_list
description: List the on-call entries during a rotation, joined with user, schedule, and escalation policy details; filterable by schedule, escalation policy, or user (GET /oncalls)

schedule_id.description: Return only on-calls for this schedule. Scalar form of the API's schedule_ids[] filter.

escalation_policy_id.description: Return only on-calls for this escalation policy. Scalar form of the API's escalation_policy_ids[] filter.

user_id.description: Return only on-calls for this user. Scalar form of the API's user_ids[] filter.

limit.description: The number of results per page. Defaults to 30.
